interpretation: This is a comparison of whole mapping pipelines. Original recorded PG uses a GRCh38 GENCODE37 CTAT reference index, two-pass Basic, right-flush indels, paired overlap minimum12 and mismatch fraction0.1. The new run uses the resident primary-assembly D8 index, runtime-default single-pass None and no indel flush, overlap minimum10 and default mismatch fraction0.01, plus other explicit/default changes tabulated. A change cannot be attributed solely to index sparsity, a single parameter or a correction of the original alignment. Original unspecified parameter defaults are not imputed from the newer binary. Contig names/lengths agree but full original reference sequence/index identity is unavailable.
